label.en: Illustrative comparison, not validation and not a forecast.

meta.reference_date_label: ASSUMPTION: the latest snapshot date serves as the world's reference date.
meta.schema: Each card has the same fields as data/worlds/1/signals.json plus optional excerpt_kind ('quote' or 'paraphrase') and date_note. observed_at is the publication date of the source. Evidence entries carry observed_at (= source.date); a snapshot may use an evidence entry only if observed_at <= as_of. snapshot_index lists, per snapshot, the card and evidence ids known on that date.
meta.snapshot_choice: ASSUMPTION: half-yearly snapshots. Each interval holds one phase of the cycle (shortage building, peak sales and first inventory warnings, memory prices turning, destocking, trough) and adds 3-6 cards.
meta.data_labels: Every card value is SOURCE (URL given); no DEMODATA or invented number is used. Lead times in months, strength, axes and reliability are ASSUMPTION-labelled judgement, as in world 1.
